# CloudTopia — Digital & Cloud Technologies

> CloudTopia is a full-service digital agency serving businesses in the Gulf (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar), Turkey, and globally. We build websites, e-commerce stores, custom business systems, QR menus, and web applications — with multilingual support for Arabic, Turkish, and English.

## What We Do

CloudTopia delivers end-to-end digital solutions:

- **Website Design & Development** — Custom-built, conversion-focused websites with advanced SEO, multilingual support (Arabic, Turkish, English), and WhatsApp/CTA integrations. One-time pricing from $399.
- **E-Commerce Stores** — Full-stack online stores with payment gateway integration (Stripe, Tap), inventory management, abandoned cart recovery, and WhatsApp notifications. From $799 one-time.
- **Business Systems (CRM & More)** — Custom CRM platforms with WhatsApp & email integration, lead management, automation flows, and reporting dashboards. From $1,299 one-time.
- **QR Menu Systems** — Instant digital menus for restaurants and cafes with QR code generation, WhatsApp order links, and free lifetime updates. From $399 one-time.
- **Web Applications** — Interactive portals, SaaS platforms, dashboards, and real-time web applications.
- **Social Media Marketing** — Content strategy, management, and paid advertising across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Snapchat.
- **Content Creation** — SEO-optimized copywriting, blog content, and marketing materials in Arabic, Turkish, and English.

## Key Facts

- **Founded:** 2022
- **Headquarters:** Turkey (serving Gulf & MENA region)
- **Languages:** Arabic, Turkish, English — all services delivered trilingually
- **Pricing model:** One-time project fees (no recurring SaaS fees for most services)
- **Markets served:** UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Turkey, and global markets
- **Contact:** info@cloudtopia.net | WhatsApp: +90 501 151 11 16
- **Website:** https://cloudtopia.net
